title: Reference bone spectra at about 0, 1, 3, 6 and 10% collagen
description: Mean absorbance log10(1/R) of the Ryder et al. 2026 reference bones whose measured collagen yield falls in each band (public supplement mmc2); R = 10^-A for display. Charts label each reference by its measured yield. readings_pct records what the shipped models read on each reference.

source.citation: Ryder et al. 2026, J. Archaeol. Sci. 185:106448, supplement mmc2

construction: mean of log10(1/max(R, 1e-6)) over members; values rounded to 7 significant digits (recomputed from mmc2 to 5e-08)
